theme: Original Primeval Dragons - the Elder Dragons and their Primeval heirs (Phase 6 Pilot 2)
status: UNAPPROVED PROPOSAL - awaiting Cory's review; not approved, not locked, not certified
narrator_note: A five-colour dragon procession. The five Legends Elder Dragons and their Core Set 2019 cards, Ugin, the Elder Dragon War, the Piru/Chromium aftermath with Dihada and Dakkon, and the Invasion Primeval Dragons speaking through their printed flavor. The Ur-Dragon is the commander only as a thematic progenitor.

commander.name: The Ur-Dragon
commander.why: The five-colour progenitor dragon. Invasion-era Attendant flavor calls each Primeval a part of 'the ur-dragon'. That this Commander 2017 card is the same being is a thematic link, not an asserted canon identity.

acts.title: I. The Elder Dragons of Dominaria and the war Bolas started

playability.why: Mana, fixing, removal or dragon support for a five-colour commander; no story claim.

canon_caveats: A003/A004 (who struck first; Ugin's perspective) are CANON_DISPUTED; no card here asserts either account.
The Ur-Dragon (C17) is not asserted to be the 'ur-dragon' of the Invasion Attendant flavor; it is a thematic commander (LORE_INSPIRED).
Original Legends Elder Dragon cards are named character cards; their art is not certified as any specific war scene.
Darigaaz, Dromar and Treva are graded CANON_REFERENCE as named character cards only. Pack A2 sources name Crosis and Rith directly, not the other three.
Printed flavor proves what Wizards printed on the card, not that the illustration depicts a specific story scene.
unrepresentable_in_identity: None by colour: five-colour identity admits every Elder and Primeval Dragon card.
Chromium Rhuell's banishment and Piru's death at Corondor have no dedicated card; Piru and Dakkon cards stand in (A021-A022).

tier_definitions.DIRECT_DEPICTION: Official Wizards story captions this exact art at the event.
tier_definitions.CANON_REFERENCE: Card is the named character/event, or its printed text or an official article ties it to the Elder/Primeval Dragon canon.
tier_definitions.LORE_INSPIRED: Named or thematic link only; no scene or event asserted.
tier_definitions.MECHANICAL_SYMBOL: Included for function; no story claim.
